description: Critical response to 2026-04-21 ML/DL 8-agent scrutiny (mean 0.33). Brutal consensus: PRISM trains models that never reach inference. 70 LoRAs sit on disk while recommendations use hardcoded physics constants. 22,721 JM Die programs are a dead corpus — indexed, not trained on, not retrieved. There is no OutcomeCaptureBus for 5 of 6 domains (only WEDM closes the loop). This envelope delivers the 11 load-bearing engines that convert PRISM from 'research notebook with a dispatcher surface' into a system that actually gets smarter over time.
rationale: Scrutiny scores: MLOps 0.32, LoRA coordination 0.28, RL 0.38, Data pipeline 0.28, Evaluation 0.42, Continual learning 0.58, RAG 0.22, Utilization 0.18. Two agents named Utilization and RAG scored ≤0.22 — the lowest scores in any scrutiny pass. Direct quote from Utilization Architect: 'Models train; inference uses constants. No, PRISM does not get smarter over time.' This is the existential gap in 'smartest manufacturing AI on the planet.'

consensus_critical_findings: PRISM does not actually learn — 5/6 domains (mill, lathe, grinder, sinker, welder) have no OutcomeCaptureBus; operator overrides disappear. Only WEDM closes the loop.
70 LoRA engines are dead weight — no MoE router, no inference-time composition, no catastrophic-forgetting protection. Adapters train nightly but inference never loads them (except WEDM).

22,721 JM Die programs are a dead corpus — scanned, indexed in JM_DIE_CORPUS_INDEX.json (332k lines), but never parsed into training examples. There is no MINFileParserEngine, no OkumaRunLogParserEngine.

Zero citations/provenance on AI recommendations — operators see values with no visibility into whether source is formula, past program, tribal tip, or hallucination. Breaks trust and ITAR/AS9100 audit.
No A/B / shadow / canary / champion-challenger — any LoRA goes from 'trained' to 'live' with no comparison. One drifted adapter poisons every downstream /auto-speed-feed call.
Planned PolicyActionEngine (U-SAV2-23) is a rule-based selector calling itself a policy — no π_θ(a|s) actually updates from outcomes.

Meta-learning is domain-siloed — real MAML exists in Lathe + PostProcessor engines, but MillingMetaLearningEngine + MetaLearningOptimizerEngine are named 'meta' without inner-loops. EWC++ is WEDM-only.
No feature store, no point-in-time correctness, no ML lineage graph — retraining is not reproducible; online/offline feature skew is the default.

units.title: OutcomeCaptureBus + UniversalFeedbackCommand — the missing spine
units.description: Highest priority. Single write path recordOutcome({domain, context, recommended, actual, delta, source, lineage_id}) that every studio/skill/dispatcher MUST call on any override, measurement, scrap event, or first-article report. Backs data/state/outcomes/<domain>.jsonl. Hook post-recommendation-capture.mjs makes it mandatory. Without this, every other unit in PSAU-LEARN has no signal to train on.
units.exit_criteria: recordOutcome() append-only with fsync+rename atomic; 6/6 domains emit outcome events on any skill invocation (mill/lathe/wedm/sinker/grinder/welder); hook enforcement blocks any recommendation that doesn't emit; lineage_id threads through every call

units.title: FeatureStoreEngine + DataQualityEngine + MLLineageEngine — reproducible training
units.description: Data-pipeline fix (score 0.28). FeatureStore: Parquet-backed offline store at mcp-server/data/features/offline/<feature_group>/<version>/*.parquet keyed on (entity_id, event_ts); DuckDB online layer <10ms reads; point-in-time joins with AS-OF semantics (no future leakage). DataQuality: Great-Expectations-style contracts per feature group (schema, nullability, range, drift). MLLineage: graph linking raw_file → parsed_record → feature_row → training_example → model_checkpoint → deployed_prediction → observed_outcome so we can answer 'which training example caused this bad prediction' in one query.
units.exit_criteria: getHistoricalFeatures(entities,timestamps) AS-OF join returns in <100ms; 0 future-leakage on 100 sampled queries; every feature row carries lineage_id traceable to raw observation; DQ contracts block bad data on red

units.title: JMDieProgramCorpusPipeline — turn 22,721 dead programs into training data
units.description: Data-pipeline fix (highest-value gap per specialist). Build MINFileParserEngine (Okuma .MIN G-code → structured ops), MastercamMcxParserEngine (.mcx-8 → strategy/tool/stock/WCS), OkumaRunLogParserEngine (controller logs → actual feedrate/spindle load/override%/alarms), TrainingExampleAssemblerEngine (joins on customer × part_no × program × date → labeled examples), JMDieTrainingCorpusEngine (orchestrator). Target: 22,721 programs → ~200k+ training examples in the feature store by end of unit.
units.exit_criteria: 100% parse coverage across 22,721 .MIN + 3,713 .mcx-8; ≥150k training examples in feature store; per-customer × per-material breakdown reported; parser rejects corrupt files with structured error, not silent drop

units.title: RAG Stack — JMDieProgramRAG + TribalRAG + ReRanker + ProvenanceEngine (score 0.22 — LOWEST)
units.description: Single largest capability gap. 129k knowledge artifacts (4493 tribal tips + 509 formulas + 6372 materials + 95608 tools + 22721 programs) and only 1 RAG engine (CAD-only). Build: (a) JMDieProgramRAGEngine — hybrid BM25 over exact G-code tokens/tool numbers/material codes + dense embeddings over geometry/feature vectors; findSimilarPrograms(newQuote) → top-5 with geometric + process similarity; (b) TribalRAGEngine — hybrid BM25+dense over 4493 tips keyed by {material, operation, machine, symptom}; (c) ReRankerEngine — cross-encoder top-10 → top-3 refinement; (d) ProvenanceEngine — every recommendation returns citations:{engine,corpus,id,excerpt,confidence} schema. Stop hook `unprovenanced-recommendation-guard.mjs` rejects any prism_ai/prism_calc recommendation without provenance.
units.exit_criteria: findSimilarPrograms returns top-5 with geometric+process scores in <200ms over 22k corpus; tribal recall@5 >0.8 on 50 labeled queries; every recommendation from prism_ai/prism_calc/prism_intelligence carries ≥1 citation; 0 unprovenanced-recommendations blocked by hook after enforcement enabled

units.title: LoRA Composition Layer — MoE router + DoRA + AdaLoRA + O-LoRA (score 0.28)
units.description: Turn 70 isolated LoRA singletons into a mixture-of-experts. LoRAMoEGatingEngine: top-K softmax router over adapter set keyed on quality-dimension vector (5-dim score already exists) + material + machine embedding. DoRAAdapterEngine: decomposed magnitude/direction updates (Liu 2024) recovers ~0.6σ over vanilla LoRA on physics-heavy domains. AdaLoRARankAllocatorEngine: SVD-based importance scoring to redistribute rank budget. O-LoRA orthogonality constraint between domain adapters to prevent cadence-induced forgetting. Additionally: collapse 10-of-10 LoRACadenceEngines + 10-of-10 LoRADatasetBuilders into parameterized singletons (70 engines → ~25 + 1 router + 1 forgetting guard).
files_modified: 50+ existing LoRA engines — collapse to parameterized config where duplicated
units.exit_criteria: single forward pass composes top-3 experts via ΔW = Σpᵢ BᵢAᵢ in <50ms; 5-dim quality score used as gating input; O-LoRA orthogonality enforced per-domain; measured LoRA compression: 70 engines → ≤30 with no capability loss

units.title: Shadow/Canary/AB/Temporal Deploy Gates — zero-theater evaluation (score 0.42)
units.description: No LoRA ships without beating incumbent on held-out JM Die jobs. ShadowModeEngine: new model predicts in parallel on live jobs for ≥30 days, outputs logged never used. ABExperimentEngine: Welch's t-test + Benjamini-Hochberg FDR, MDE calculator, SRM check, always-valid p-values (mSPRT). ChampionChallengerRegistryEngine: track record per model. TemporalHoldoutEngine: enforces train.max(ts) < test.min(ts); LeakageAuditorEngine crawls feature-extraction DAG flagging post-split aggregations. CUPEDEngine: variance reduction on noisy cycle-time metrics. ModelReceiptEngine: signed, human-readable per-customer 'Model v2 cut cycle time by 8% ± 2%' scorecard operators can print.
units.exit_criteria: no model ships without 30-day shadow + bootstrap CI on worst-case subgroup > 0 + operator double-signoff on 3 low-stakes jobs + 5%→25%→100% canary ramp with drift-gated circuit-breaker; ModelReceipt printable per-customer; leakage auditor flags 100% of seeded violations in test suite

units.title: AdapterHotSwapEngine + InferenceLoRAGate — actually USE the LoRAs (score 0.18)
units.description: THE single most impactful unit in the whole envelope. Today every recommendation engine calls physics/constants.ts + ShopConfigurationEngine defaults — LoRAs on disk are never consulted. InferenceLoRAGate wraps every recommendation engine's output: (a) load active adapter from LoRAAdapterRegistry keyed on (domain, material, op, machine), (b) apply PhysicsOutcomeCalibrator residual from historical deltas, (c) emit adapterUsed + residualApplied in provenance. AdapterHotSwapEngine handles atomic swap on registry update. This is the ONE belt that connects the 70-cylinder engine (training) to the wheels (inference).
units.exit_criteria: every recommendation engine routes through InferenceLoRAGate; measured adapter-hit-rate ≥ 40% on real JM Die quote workload; adapter swap atomic with 0-downtime; provenance field 'adapterUsed' present on 100% of recommendations

units.title: Offline RL — IQL + MaxEnt IRL + Safety Shield (score 0.38)
units.description: RL specialist fix. Replace tabular Q-learning in LatheReinforcementLearningEngine with IQL (Kostrikov 2021) — avoids OOD action problem via expectile regression on V(s) + weighted behavior cloning for π. JM Die's 20k+ programs = offline dataset; wet runs only validate. MaxEntIRLEngine (Ziebart) recovers r_θ(s,a) from OperatorOverrideLedger — operator overrides are the highest-SNR feedback PRISM has. SafetyShieldEngine wraps policy in CMDP formulation: maximize learned reward subject to P(F_c > F_limit) < 1e-4 and E[tool_life] > 0.8·nominal via control-barrier functions over Kienzle physics envelope. Any action shield rejects never reaches the machine.
units.exit_criteria: IQL learns from 20k-program offline dataset; MaxEnt IRL reward model predicts operator preferences with accuracy ≥ 75% on held-out overrides; SafetyShield rejects 100% of Kienzle-envelope violations in red-team test; no ε-greedy exploration on live machines

units.title: PolicyExperienceLedger + RewardLedger + OutcomeTrace — (s,a,r,s') substrate
units.description: RL prerequisites (score 0.38). PolicyExperienceLedgerEngine: every job produces (state, action, reward_observed, next_state) tuple keyed to feature-store snapshot. RewardLedgerEngine: per-objective reward decomposition (cycle/life/quality/cost/safety) with z-score normalization per (material × machine × tool) tuple — kills ratio-gaming attack. OutcomeTraceEngine: threads lineage_id from recommendation → action → outcome → next policy update. Storage: JSONL per shift promoted to training nightly.
units.exit_criteria: every shop-floor job produces ≥1 experience tuple; reward decomposition validated by multi-objective Pareto set demo; lineage_id threads 100% of outcome events to triggering recommendation

units.title: Continual Learning Unified — EWC+SI+DER++ + TestTimeAdaptation + LearningCascade + FedLoRA
units.description: Continual learning fix (score 0.58, best of the ML scores but domain-siloed). ContinualLoRAEngine: unify WEDMEWCMemory + LatheContinualLearning into cross-domain engine with Synaptic Intelligence (SI, Zenke 2017) for cheap online consolidation + EWC++ for weekly snapshots + DER++ (Dark Experience Replay, Buzzega 2020 extended 2023) replacing rating-sort with KL-distillation on replayed logits. TestTimeAdaptationEngine (EATA, ICML 2022): entropy minimization on reliable+non-redundant samples when drift detector fires, adapts only BN affine + LoRA-A. LearningCascadeEngine: propagation graph — confirmed outcome fan-out to LoRA-fine-tune + TribalKB structured tuple + Playbook rule-proposal (auto-promote at N=5). FederatedLoRAEngine: FedAvg over LoRA-A matrices only when multiple customers share (material, operation, machine-class) — 2024 federated-LoRA pattern.
units.exit_criteria: EWC++ active on all 6 domains (was WEDM-only); cross-customer knowledge cascade propagates chatter-lobe shift from Machine 14/ITW to Machine 8/Holo-Krome in <1 training cycle; TTA engages on Page-Hinkley drift and stays bounded (BN+LoRA-A only); no catastrophic forgetting on Split-manufacturing benchmark

units.title: ProtoMAML Few-Shot Adapter — new-customer <10 samples
units.description: Continual learning fix. Today when ITW sends 3 new nickel-alloy parts, LoRA predicts from base policy + operator corrects + corrections train TONIGHT (not during quote). Wire meta-trained MAML initialization into 5-step inner-loop inside quote-to-ship dispatcher. ProtoMAML (Triantafillou 2020) = Prototypical Networks init + MAML fine-tune — 2024 consensus for <10-sample regression. Fix MillingMetaLearningEngine + MetaLearningOptimizerEngine (named 'meta' but no inner-loop today). Cache adapted head per-customer-material in LoRA registry.
units.exit_criteria: on 3-shot support set + query point, returns adapted prediction in <500ms; MAE on held-out new-customer parts within 1.2× of fully-trained baseline; inner-loop fires inside quote path not tonight's cron
